snippet.title: Space Cats Trailer
snippet.description:
"Space Cats": Zip around as a space cat dodging rockets and grabbing Catnip for double points and a trippy speed boost. A fresh, funny game with a nod to internet culture, blending challenge, humor, and nostalgia.

Coming soon to Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2892290/Space_Cats/
